result.paraphrase: Gigabyte 120GB 2.5-inch internal SSD with SATA 6.0Gb/s, offering up to 500 MB/s read and 380 MB/s write speeds, plus 50k/60k random IOPS. It measures 69.85 x 7 x 100 mm, uses NAND flash, supports HMB, TRIM and S.M.A.R.T., and has a 2M-hour MTBF. Rated at 2240mW active read power and 2610mW active write power, 170mW idle, it operates from 0C to 70C and stores from -40C to 85C. Limited 3-year warranty or 75TBW, whichever comes first.
